set.body: Teach fixed-metric analytic uncertainty in cross_partitions, pairing, contrast, RDM, crossnobis, relation, and relation_fit documentation. State that edges sharing partitions are not replicates; cite Diedrichsen et al. Eqs. 10/13/35 and Section 5.1; give a supported recipe/API; explain beta-only and learned-metric limitations without presenting subject resampling as recovered first-level uncertainty.
set.title: Document analytic uncertainty, citations, and entry-path limits
